svg.title: Kalman filter with right and wrong reading uncertainty
svg.desc: With the reading's true 5 millimetre standard deviation the filter estimates tank 1 within 2 millimetres from 25 seconds. Assuming 0.25 millimetres it trusts the noisy reading, falls 15.6 centimetres low at 4 seconds and claims an accuracy it does not have; assuming 100 millimetres it hardly uses the reading and is still 5.1 millimetres low at 31 seconds.
svg.text: Kalman filter with right and wrong reading uncertainty
Control Studio recordings of this project · same slug and same 5 mm reading noise · numbers answer the predictions
Within 2 mm from 25 s; RMS 0.23 mm, claims 0.54 mm
Gain 19.5: falls 15.6 cm low at 4 s; RMS 1.01 mm, claims 0.34 mm
Gain 0.003: still 5.1 mm low at 31 s; within 2 mm only from 53 s
